CNV-ECO-003.append: Each enterprise configuration SHALL name whose margin is tested (sponsor, administrator or Unbound) and SHALL be called viable only if that party's margin is non-negative at P90 cost and adverse licence scale. Volumes that depend on partner distribution SHALL be labelled scenario assumptions until willingness-to-distribute records exist from at least three partners. The vendor P&L SHALL include platform registration, annual reporting and compliance costs for each jurisdiction where Unbound must register.
acceptance_add: Given an enterprise configuration with a negative tested-party margin at P90 cost and adverse licence, when reported, then it is labelled not viable.

CNV-ECO-004.append: The OD-M-04 reopening trigger SHALL be expressed against the target list as the signed share of listed sponsors under 10,000 funds, with a second trigger when lost deals cite the absence of staffed services; until the target list exists, the count of five is used [policy default, owner: product owner]. The economics pack SHALL disclose sponsor concentration for years 1–3, and a concentration exception record SHALL be required whenever one sponsor exceeds 25% of recurring revenue in any quarter after year 3.
acceptance_add: Given a quarter in year 4 where one sponsor provides 30% of recurring revenue, when the economics pack is produced, then a concentration exception record is required.

CNV-GOV-008.append: Every delegation SHALL carry an expiry no later than 12 months after adoption [policy default, owner: sponsor board]; board-report samples SHALL be sized by the CNV-GRT-011 error-bound method. The baseline index SHALL show each clause's approval basis, and an approved-claims register keyed to clause ids SHALL be checked before any customer-facing publication.
acceptance_add: Given a delegation recorded without an expiry, when saved, then it is rejected.

CNV-ARC-001.append: After any restore or regional failover, dispatch for the affected cell SHALL stay blocked until hold publications after the restore point are re-applied, in-flight instructions are reconciled with the rail, and the cell's ledger is reconciled to the last bank feed; the recovery semantics SHALL be approved by the sponsor before production.
acceptance_add: Given a regional failover, when the cell restarts, then dispatch remains blocked until hold re-application and in-flight reconciliation are recorded.

CNV-ARC-005.append: Each tenant SHALL have a restore test at least annually and credential and key rotation evidence; a PostgreSQL major-version upgrade drill SHALL be completed before architecture acceptance.

CNV-GOV-004.append: The one-sponsor rule SHALL be enforced by a privacy-preserving person token in the shared store, matched exactly, returning only 'already appointed elsewhere' to the appointing sponsor.

CNV-GOV-001.append: A 'planned approach pending' status SHALL expire after one sponsor audit cycle or 12 months, whichever is sooner [policy default, owner: sponsor CFO]; the interim evidence pack SHALL be generated at least monthly; expiry without a recorded approach SHALL suspend delegated automation for that sponsor.

CNV-FIN-004.append: The controller decision on an unattributable break SHALL be due within a sponsor-set number of business days not exceeding the next statement publication date.
acceptance_add: Given an unattributable $500 break on a pooled account, when statements are due, then a controller decision is open and statements are not withheld silently.

CNV-PAY-007.append: The attestation window SHALL be approved by the treasurer and SHALL NOT exceed two business days; attesters SHALL be distinct from the releasing approvers; the bank-portal evidence SHALL be stored with the attestation.
acceptance_add: Given an AlternativeBalanceAttestation signed by a releasing approver, when used, then it is rejected.

CNV-PLT-010.append: Ledger digests SHALL be anchored externally at least daily so tampering is detectable, and production database administrative roles SHALL be break-glass only, with two-person activation.
acceptance_add: Given a ledger row altered outside the application, when the daily digest is verified, then the mismatch is detected and alerted.

CNV-PLT-011.append: The post-change hold SHALL also cover bank-detail changes and, for charities, contact and authorised-signatory changes. Contact assurance levels SHALL be defined by factor combination: CAL0 unverified; CAL1 knowledge or caller identification only; CAL2 one-time code to a validated phone or email, or callback to the number on record; CAL3 an in-session authenticator challenge at AAL2 or above; each accessible method SHALL state the CAL it yields, and relay calls SHALL reach the same CAL as voice calls.
acceptance_add: Given a charity contact change followed by a bank-detail change within the hold period, when release is requested, then it is held.
Given a relay-service call completing the CAL2 callback method, when assessed, then it reaches CAL2.

replace: then an Accessibility Conformance Report from automated tests plus manual assistive-technology testing exists.

then its Accessibility Conformance Report from automated tests plus manual assistive-technology testing shows no open WCAG 2.2 Level A or AA failure without a signed exception, and every Forma component used has a recorded conformance statement or Unbound test.
wording SHALL be validated by sponsor usability research
wording SHALL be validated by moderated sponsor usability testing with a recorded task-success criterion set before the test
rejecting rules that overlap with different outcomes.
accepting overlapping rules with different outcomes when the lattice orders their sources (recording the winner) and rejecting them only when both sources sit at the same level.

CNV-PLT-012.append: Activation of a rail partner SHALL require contract terms for instruction status queries and segregated holding of sponsor funds in transit.

CNV-FIN-003.append: Unless the treasurer approves other weights, the weight SHALL be zero after the applicable return window and the warranty-claim tail SHALL be covered by the sponsor's loss provision instead.
replace: Given a donor whose only un-matured gifts are 70 to 700 days old, when a new contribution arrives, then the exposure cap is not triggered by them.
Given default weights and a donor whose only consumer ACH gifts are 70 to 700 days old, when a new contribution arrives, then those gifts carry zero weight and do not trigger the cap.
